current_exact_phase10a_schema_replay.stream_transport: gzip decompression through a FIFO; no second uncompressed copy retained
current_exact_phase10a_schema_replay.extractor_timing_classification: compiled-environment extraction over already available outputs; not a clean or fresh-output library build

public_declarations.universe: uniquely owned environment declarations attributed to modules named NumStability or NumStability.* in the environment obtained by importing NumStability

public_with_incoming_project_reference.formula: count(public target B where exists unique union edge A -> B)

public_used_from_another_module.formula: count(public target B where exists unique union edge A -> B and owner(A) != owner(B))

cross_module_union_edges.formula: cardinality of {(A,B) in signature_edges union body_edges | owner(A) != owner(B)}

edge_contract.direction: A -> B means the elaborated type or body/proof of A directly references B
edge_contract.deduplication: each edge set is a set of declaration-name pairs; repeated occurrences are removed; a pair in type and body is counted once in union
edge_contract.module_ownership: Environment.getModuleIdxFor? selects the unique originating module; repeated re-exported moduleData entries are discarded

authorship_and_generated_names.evidence: The exact extractor has no isReservedName or source-origin filter. The snapshot counts constructors and recursors and the Phase 10A migration record explicitly identifies a generated congr_simp theorem classified public.

recovered_library_audit.relationship_to_2bb76d0: The existing ignored 2bb76d0 CSV/JSON files have the exact schemas produced by this recovered tree and their metadata records commit 2bb76d0 with untracked tools; however no contemporaneous tool-hash manifest was stored, so byte identity at the July 21 execution time is strongly supported but not cryptographically proven.
recovered_library_audit.can_run_against_target: DeclarationGraph.lean and analyze_graph.py run from the external recovery location without source changes. capture_baseline.py derives the repository root from its own location and therefore must either be copied byte-for-byte to <isolated-worktree>/tools/library_audit or invoked through a path-only wrapper/adaptation.

why_recovered_library_audit_is_not_a_dro: It uses Name.isInternal while Phase 10A uses Name.isInternalDetail.
It erases self references while Phase 10A does not explicitly erase them.
It obtains bodies through ConstantInfo.value? true and therefore omits recursor-rule RHS dependencies that Phase 10A explicitly collects.
Its public weak-component metric counts public nodes in the largest all-declaration component, whereas Phase 10A computes the largest component of the public-induced graph.
comparison_assessment.additional_evidence_needed_for_detailed_: Regenerate the Phase 10A raw format-2 TSV at d21a4ed with the exact recovered extractor, then compare it to an exact-schema target extraction.
